observations: Single bicycle photographed outdoors on concrete ground, angled view from rear-low angle.
Front suspension fork visible (shock absorber type).
Disc brakes visible on both front and rear wheels.
Rear derailleur and multi-sprocket cassette visible, suggesting multiple gears.
Frame is dark (black/navy) with green/yellow decal accents; no readable brand or model text on frame.
A watermark reading 'AUSTIN BODY' appears across the image, partially obscuring details.
A person's legs/feet are visible in the background, not part of the item.
No close-up of shifters, frame decals, or serial numbers provided.
Seller's new message is a verbal reassurance only; no new photo or video was provided.

claims.evidence: Subjective marketing claim, not something a photo can confirm.
Photo 0 shows a derailleur and cassette consistent with multiple gears, but individual speed count cannot be confirmed from this angle.
Photo 0 clearly shows a front suspension fork.
No receipt, box, or purchase date evidence shown.
Seller now claims personal testing yesterday, but this is a verbal assertion with no accompanying video or demonstration; photo is static.
Visible frame and components in photo 0 appear clean, but close-up of joints, bottom bracket, and spokes not shown.
Cannot confirm originality of components from a single exterior photo.

claims.claim: "I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true"
claims.evidence: A seller's verbal assurance is not photographic or video evidence; no new proof was supplied.

risks.risk: Gear shifting may not work smoothly across all claimed 18 speeds
risks.proof: A video showing the rider shifting through each gear on both front and rear derailleurs
risks.if_unproven: priced as gears not fully functional

risks.risk: Brakes may not engage properly or may be worn
risks.proof: A video or clear photo showing brake pads and a brake test (squeezing lever, wheel stopping)
risks.if_unproven: priced as brakes not confirmed working

risks.risk: Hidden rust or corrosion on frame joints, chain, or spokes
risks.proof: Close-up photos of bottom bracket, chain, and spoke nipples in good lighting
risks.if_unproven: priced as rust possible/not confirmed rust-free

risks.risk: Frame size and wheel size unknown, which affects usability and price
risks.proof: A photo showing frame size sticker or a tape measure against the frame/wheel

risks.risk: Watermark 'Austin Body' suggests image may be from a dealer or stock catalogue rather than the actual item in seller's possession
risks.proof: A fresh photo without watermark, taken in the seller's current location with a handwritten note or timestamp
risks.if_unproven: priced with added uncertainty on item identity/condition

risks.risk: Tires may be worn or underinflated, not visible in detail
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tire tread and sidewalls
risks.if_unproven: priced as tires in unknown/worn condition

proof_requests: Video of the bicycle being ridden or at least pedaled with visible gear shifting through multiple speeds.
Close-up photo of the brake levers and pads engaging the wheel.
Close-up photo of the frame's bottom bracket, chain, and spoke area for rust check.
A fresh, unwatermarked photo of the actual bicycle in the seller's current location, ideally with today's date or a handwritten note visible.
Photo of any frame size/model sticker if present.
response.reason: A verbal reassurance without new photographic or video evidence does not change the verification status of any claim; the bicycle is still priced at worst case for unproven gear function, brake condition, and rust until visual proof is supplied.
